item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"learning_objective","rationale":"Retain the existing weighted BPR objective and add 0.1 times the mean pairwise softplus loss over the same valid targets and sampled negatives. This encourages ranking improvements across all four datasets without changing sampling, architecture, scoring, or training settings.","edits":[{"find":"    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)\n    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum()","replace":"    pairwise_loss = torch.nn.functional.softplus(valid_neg - valid_pos)\n    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum() + 0.1 * pairwise_loss.mean()"}]}],"change_summary":"Add a modest unweighted pairwise ranking term to the existing loss for all four category models. Prediction and checkpoint formats remain compatible."}
